chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to eat fresh dates with melon.

key_terms.الرُّطَب: Fresh dates (dates at the rutab stage)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet eat with fresh dates according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: This brief narration from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) practice of combining fresh dates (rutab) with melon (kharbaz), reflecting the Shia emphasis on following the Sunnah in daily dietary habits. Scholars often cite this to illustrate the permissibility of mixing foods with differing thermal qualities, a concept central to traditional Islamic medicine (tibb). It underscores the Prophet’s moderation and enjoyment of permissible worldly pleasures as part of a balanced spiritual life.
